policy: Publish reviewed Guide/authored evidence bytes; preserve and move already-public evidence byte-exact. Newly captured full portal wrappers/PDF/image or reader payloads with uncleared reuse are omitted, without importing their unpublished commit ancestry. Necessary attributed statutory excerpts remain in ledgers. Omitted bytes remain intact in the separate research checkout and local research Git commit.
rights_basis: Faroese Copyright Act30/2015 §9 excludes laws, regulations, public circulars, judgments and similar public documents, with §9(2) independent-contribution caveat; this is not a blanket licence for portal wrappers, navigation, images or database extraction. No such blanket clearance is asserted.
historical_manifest_policy: Historical reviewed manifests, ledgers and review artifacts are preserved byte-exact. Their capture paths/hashes remain historical references, not promises that the omitted source payload is publicly distributed. This map explains every omission; no placeholder bytes or edited hashes replace the captures.
